desc: Add typed decomposition manifest validation and propagation: `models.DecompositionManifest` on output entries and generated child tasks, `set-task-output` validation for decomposition-root outputs including required `plan_ref`/`arch_ref`, duplicate/circular/catch-all rejection, read-only dependency mirroring, non-root backward compatibility, and `buildChildTask` copying of refs, kind, dependencies, inherited phase-gate dependencies, and decomposition metadata.
done_when: `models.DecompositionManifest` exists with JSON/YAML fields `owned_files`, `owned_modules`, `read_only_depends_on`, `read_only_task_depends_on`, `interfaces_owned`, `interfaces_consumed`, and `coverage_notes`; `models.OutputEntry` and generated child `models.Task` both persist optional `decomposition` metadata; `liza set-task-output` requires `decomposition` and the role-appropriate artifact ref (`plan_ref` for `epic-planning-main-pair`, `arch_ref` for `architecture-main-pair`, `plan_ref` for `code-planning-main-pair`) on every output from a decomposition-root task while preserving non-root backward compatibility; validation rejects duplicate sibling `owned_files`, duplicate sibling `interfaces_owned`, empty ownership declarations, catch-all ownership strings, invalid or self `read_only_depends_on`, `read_only_depends_on` not mirrored in `depends_on`, invalid or missing `read_only_task_depends_on` targets, `read_only_task_depends_on` not mirrored in `task_depends_on`, invalid sibling `depends_on`, and circular sibling `depends_on`; `buildChildTask` copies `Decomposition`, `Kind`, `PlanRef`, `ArchRef`, `EpicRef`, sibling dependency IDs, external `task_depends_on`, and inherited phase-gate dependencies to child tasks, preserves existing parent `arch_ref` and `epic_ref` fallback behavior, and does not introduce parent `plan_ref` fallback; focused tests in `internal/models`, `internal/ops`, and any touched command projection package pass.
scope: `internal/models/task.go` and focused model serialization tests for `DecompositionManifest`, `OutputEntry.Decomposition`, and `Task.Decomposition`; `internal/ops/set_task_output.go` and tests for decomposition-root output validation, required master refs, duplicate ownership, circular dependencies, catch-all ownership rejection, read-only dependency mirroring, and non-root backward compatibility; `internal/ops/proceed.go` and tests proving child tasks copy decomposition metadata, artifact refs, sibling dependencies, external task dependencies, and inherited phase-gate dependencies without adding parent `plan_ref` fallback; `internal/commands/inspect_tasks.go` and focused JSON tests only if explicit inspect DTOs otherwise hide decomposition metadata. Consume the decomposition-root resolver/schema contract from `architecture-1-code-planning-0-a` and `architecture-1-code-planning-0-b`; do not edit embedded pipeline topology, initial-planning wake templates, master doer/reviewer prompt sections, documentation, ADRs, or end-to-end scenario tests in this scope.
